messages.author: 414befbf107db25f
messages.subject: choice perseveration in bandit4arm models
parts:
Hi everyone,

We would like to add a choice perseveration factor in the bandit4arm models, to see whether it improves the fit of the models.
To do this, I tried to calculate the lag-1 autocorrelation of the choice history, and then multiply it to a free parameter ("cons"), which in turn is added to the softmax of the value and noise. It is not working (please see script attached). Could anyone help me with this?

Thanks very much,

Flavia

messages.author: 77a287453637d027
messages.subject: Re: choice perseveration in bandit4arm models
parts:
Hi Flavia,

As I checked your code attached, it seems the file has two problems. First, you didn't define "g" before Line 91. Adding a line with "real g;" near Line 80 will resolve the error. Second, you used the function "acf" in Line 91, but it works only on R but not on Stan. If you want to calculate the autocorrelation between choices on Stan, it would be better to define a custom function on Stan (see more on this link).

FYI, the latest version of RStudio supports the Stan language and provides convenient features. I highly recommend you to check it out and try it by yourself.

Best,
Jaeyeong
